title: Removal of the ionophore antibiotic narasin using vegetal materials as bioadsorbents

The occurrence of ionophore antibiotics, particularly narasin (NAR), in the environment, has recently become a matter of concern because of their widespread use, high eco-toxicity, and environmental persistence.
